* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

caf16 (and all)
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC20G4.01

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

Annotation.

PomBase, and members of the community who work on CCR4-NOT  do not detect this in TAP purifications. it seems to data back  to some fairly  legacy  2-hybrid analysis. https://www.jbc.org/article/S0021-9258(19)67211-X/fulltext


We would like to classify this as an "unknown" in PomBase  to bring it back onto people's radar, since its clearly not CCR4-NOT


* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
